sidebar_added_detected: Toast after adding a folder that has no atlas.yaml: what Atlas detected and how many services it will run. {stack} is the stack named in words ("Node project"), {count} the number of services.
sidebar_added_nothing: Toast after adding a folder that has no atlas.yaml when Atlas recognised no stack in it.
sidebar_clear_filter: Accessible name of the button that clears the worktree filter field of the left sidebar. Also in the Find projects dialog.
sidebar_command_remove_missing: Command palette entry that removes every project whose folder is gone. Only listed while some project is missing.
sidebar_command_remove_project: Command palette entry that removes the active project from Atlas. It opens a confirmation, hence the ellipsis.
sidebar_delete_dialog_body: Help line of the dialog that confirms deleting worktrees. Says what is removed and when a branch is kept.
sidebar_delete_dialog_force: Checkbox of the delete worktree dialog. Forcing throws away uncommitted changes and also deletes a branch that was not merged.
sidebar_delete_dialog_title: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting worktrees. {count} is how many are selected; one is a single worktree.
sidebar_discover_dialog_add_root: Button of the Find projects dialog that opens a folder picker to scan one more folder.
sidebar_discover_dialog_add_selected: Primary button of the Find projects dialog that adds the ticked folders. {count} is how many are ticked; without any the button is disabled and shows no number.
sidebar_discover_dialog_cancelled: Status line of the Find projects dialog after the user cancelled the scan. {count} picks the plural, {amount} is the folder count already formatted, {seconds} the elapsed seconds with one decimal.
sidebar_discover_dialog_candidates_note: Note above the Could use Atlas list of the Find projects dialog: folders with a project file but no atlas.yaml.
sidebar_discover_dialog_candidates_switc: Switch of the Find projects dialog that includes folders without an atlas.yaml in the scan.
sidebar_discover_dialog_could_use_atlas: Heading of the list of folders without an atlas.yaml in the Find projects dialog.
sidebar_discover_dialog_create_atlas_yam: Button on a Find projects result without atlas.yaml that writes one in that folder.
sidebar_discover_dialog_elsewhere: Heading of the group of Find projects results that sit outside every scanned folder. On macOS they come from Spotlight, which the heading names.
sidebar_discover_dialog_filter_placehold: Placeholder of the filter field in the Find projects dialog.
sidebar_discover_dialog_filter_results: Accessible name of the filter field in the Find projects dialog.
sidebar_discover_dialog_find_projects: Title of the Find projects dialog, and the tooltip and accessible name of the footer button that opens it.
sidebar_discover_dialog_init_title: Tooltip of the Create atlas.yaml button on a Find projects result: says what the button writes and where.
sidebar_discover_dialog_lead: Help line under the Find projects title. Spotlight is a macOS feature, so only the macOS text names it.
sidebar_discover_dialog_moved_copy: Hint on a Find projects result that looks like the new home of a missing project. {name} is the missing project's name, shown in bold.
sidebar_discover_dialog_no_config: Empty line of the Find projects dialog when no folder has an atlas.yaml but the Could use Atlas list below is not empty.
sidebar_discover_dialog_none: Empty line of the Find projects dialog when the scan found nothing and no filter is set.
sidebar_discover_dialog_pick_root: Title of the native folder picker opened by Add folder to scan.
sidebar_discover_dialog_scanned: Status line of the Find projects dialog after a scan finished. {count} picks the plural, {amount} is the folder count already formatted, {seconds} the elapsed seconds with one decimal.
sidebar_discover_dialog_scanning: Status line of the Find projects dialog while the scan runs. {count} picks the plural, {amount} is the folder count already formatted, {seconds} the elapsed seconds with one decimal, {found} how many projects were found so far.
sidebar_discover_dialog_tag_in_atlas: Tag on a Find projects result that is already a project in the sidebar.
sidebar_discover_dialog_tag_package: Tag on a Find projects result that is a package inside another project (a monorepo package).
sidebar_discover_dialog_unreadable: Second part of the finished scan status line, after a separator the screen draws: how many folders the scan could not read. {count} picks the plural, {amount} is the same number formatted. Never shown with a zero count.
sidebar_filter_worktrees: Placeholder of the filter field at the top of the left sidebar.
sidebar_footer_settings: Tooltip and accessible name of the Settings button in the left sidebar footer.
sidebar_hide_sidebar: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that hides the left sidebar.
sidebar_loose_files_close_file: Accessible name of the x button on a file of the sidebar's Files group (files opened on their own). {name} is the file name.
sidebar_loose_files_files: Heading of the sidebar group of files opened on their own.
sidebar_loose_files_show_all: Button under the sidebar's Files group that expands the list. {count} is how many files are open in total.
sidebar_loose_files_show_fewer: Button under the sidebar's Files group that collapses the list back to the most recent files.
sidebar_missing_count: Count in the warning bar of the left sidebar when some projects have no folder any more, next to Refresh and Remove all. {count} is how many; the zero text is never shown there.
sidebar_no_match: Empty line of the left sidebar when the filter matches no worktree. {filter} is the filter text.
sidebar_no_projects: Empty state of the left sidebar when no project was added yet.
sidebar_not_found: Small tag on a project or worktree row whose folder is gone.
sidebar_not_found_at: Tooltip of a project or worktree row whose folder is gone. {root} is the folder path Atlas expected.
sidebar_other_projects: Heading of the collapsible list of the projects that are not active, when one is active.
sidebar_project_head_hide_worktrees: Accessible name of the arrow that collapses the worktrees of a project row. {name} is the project name.
sidebar_project_head_new_worktree: Tooltip and accessible name of the plus button on a project row that opens the new worktree dialog.
sidebar_project_head_open: Accessible name of a project row that is not the active one: activating it opens that project. {name} is the project name.
sidebar_project_head_running: Tooltip of the status dot of a project whose stack is running.
sidebar_project_head_show_worktrees: Accessible name of the arrow that expands the worktrees of a project row. {name} is the project name.
sidebar_project_head_stopped: Tooltip of the status dot of a project whose stack is stopped.
sidebar_project_head_worktrees: Count on a collapsed project row of the checkouts it has, main one included. {count} is the number; never below 2 there.
sidebar_projects_add_title: Title of the native folder picker of Add project, and the confirm button when the picked folder is inside another project.
sidebar_projects_all_found: Toast after Refresh projects when no project is missing and none came back.
sidebar_projects_already_added: Toast when the folder the user picked or dropped is already a project; it is selected instead. {name} is the project name.
sidebar_projects_found_again: Toast after Refresh projects when projects that were missing are back. {count} is how many.
sidebar_projects_inside_body: Body of the dialog shown when the picked folder is inside a project: the project is added, not the subfolder. {picked} is the folder the user picked, {root} the project folder.
sidebar_projects_inside_title: Title of the dialog shown when the picked folder is inside a project. {name} is the folder name.
sidebar_projects_locate_title: Title of the native folder picker of Locate, used to point a missing project at its new folder.
sidebar_projects_not_found: Toast after Refresh projects when some projects have no folder. {count} is how many.
sidebar_projects_relinked: Toast after a missing project was pointed at a new folder. {name} is the project, {dir} the folder path.
sidebar_projects_remove_missing_note: Second line of the body of the dialog that removes every missing project, under the list of their names.
sidebar_projects_remove_missing_title: Title of the dialog that removes every missing project. {count} is how many.
sidebar_projects_remove_title: Title of the dialog that removes one project from Atlas. {name} is the project name.
sidebar_projects_removed_missing: Toast after every missing project was removed. {count} is how many.
sidebar_refresh: Button text and accessible name for refreshing: the missing projects bar of the left sidebar and the right sidebar.
sidebar_refresh_projects: Tooltip, accessible name and command palette entry that re-check every project on disk.
sidebar_remove_all: Button of the missing projects bar, and confirm button of the dialog that removes every missing project.
sidebar_remove_linked: Last line of the body of the Remove from Atlas dialog: the linked worktrees of the project go too. {count} is how many; the zero text is never shown there.
sidebar_remove_note: First line of the body of the Remove from Atlas dialog, under the project path: nothing on disk is deleted.
sidebar_remove_stops: Line of the body of the Remove from Atlas dialog, shown only when the project's stack is running.
sidebar_right_copied: Toast after Copy command copied the agent's resume command to the clipboard.
sidebar_right_copy_command: Button on an expanded agent session of the right sidebar that copies the command that resumes it.
sidebar_right_empty_body: Empty state of the Agents tab, shown when the scope is Project or All.
sidebar_right_empty_body_hint: Empty state of the Agents tab, shown when the scope is Workspace: the same text plus a pointer to the Project and All options of the scope selector.
sidebar_right_empty_title: Title of the empty state of the Agents tab of the right sidebar.
sidebar_right_history: Heading of the list of past agent sessions in the right sidebar, under Running here.
sidebar_right_no_earlier_here: Line shown when agents run here but no earlier session exists for the Project or All scope.
sidebar_right_no_earlier_worktree: Line shown when agents run here but no earlier session exists for the Workspace scope, that is this worktree.
sidebar_right_no_match: Empty line of the Agents tab when the search finds no session. {query} is the search text.
sidebar_right_no_ports_body: Help line of the empty state of the Ports tab, with an example command to run.
sidebar_right_no_ports_title: Title of the empty state of the Ports tab: no process of this worktree listens on a port.
sidebar_right_open_external: Tooltip of the button that opens a port in the system browser instead of the app's own.
sidebar_right_open_port_external: Accessible name of the button that opens a port in the system browser. {port} is the port number.
sidebar_right_pin: Tooltip and accessible name of the button that pins the right sidebar as a dock while it only peeks from the edge.
sidebar_right_ports: Name of the Ports tab of the right sidebar: ports the worktree's processes listen on.
sidebar_right_resume: Button on an expanded agent session that resumes it in a terminal.
sidebar_right_resume_in_native_chat: Button on an expanded omp session that resumes it in the app's native chat instead of a terminal.
sidebar_right_reveal: Button on an expanded agent session that shows its session file in the file manager.
sidebar_right_running_here: Heading of the list of agents running now in this worktree, in the right sidebar.
sidebar_right_scope_all: Option of the session scope selector: sessions of every project.
sidebar_right_scope_project: Option of the session scope selector: sessions of every worktree of the project.
sidebar_right_scope_workspace: Option of the session scope selector: only sessions of the current worktree. Called workspace in English; in Portuguese it says worktree because that is what it filters on.
sidebar_right_search_sessions: Placeholder and accessible name of the session search field of the Agents tab.
sidebar_right_show_sessions_of: Accessible name of the scope selector of the Agents tab; its options (workspace, project, all) complete the phrase.
sidebar_row_menu_archive: Menu item of a worktree that hides it from the list until Show archived is ticked.
sidebar_row_menu_create_crewmate: Menu item of a project or worktree that opens Crew with this project linked to a new crewmate.

sidebar_row_menu_delete.description: Menu item of a worktree that deletes it. The ellipsis says it opens a confirmation first.
sidebar_row_menu_delete.distinct: the ellipsis says the item opens a confirmation dialog; the plain Delete button deletes at once

sidebar_row_menu_mark_read: Menu item that clears the unread dot of a worktree.
sidebar_row_menu_mark_unread: Menu item that puts the unread dot on a worktree.
sidebar_row_menu_new_terminal: Menu item of a project or worktree that opens a terminal there.
sidebar_row_menu_open_in_editor: Menu item of a project or worktree that opens its folder in the external editor.
sidebar_row_menu_rename_title: Title of the prompt that renames a worktree. The confirm button is the common Rename.
sidebar_row_menu_unarchive: Menu item of an archived worktree that brings it back to the list.
sidebar_show_archived: Checkbox under the left sidebar list, shown when some worktree is archived.
sidebar_step_add: Progress line under a worktree being created while git adds the checkout. Step add of worktree://progress.
sidebar_step_fetch: Progress line under a worktree being created while git fetches the remote. Step fetch of worktree://progress.
sidebar_step_seed: Progress line under a worktree being created while the heavy folders of the main checkout (dependencies, build output) are copied. Step seed of worktree://progress.
sidebar_step_shared: Progress line under a worktree being created while the files that atlas.yaml shares between worktrees are linked. Step shared of worktree://progress.
sidebar_worktree_row_main: Name of the row of a project's main checkout in the worktree list; linked worktrees show their own name.
sidebar_worktree_row_pr: Chip of a worktree with a linked pull request whose state is not known yet. {number} is the pull request number.
sidebar_worktree_row_pr_closed: Pull request state word in the chip of a worktree row: closed without merge. Value CLOSED of gh.
sidebar_worktree_row_pr_merged: Pull request state word in the chip of a worktree row: merged. Value MERGED of gh.

sidebar_worktree_row_pr_open.description: Pull request state word in the chip of a worktree row: open. Value OPEN of gh.
sidebar_worktree_row_pr_open.distinct: a lower-case state word inside a chip, not the Open action

sidebar_worktree_row_pr_state: Chip of a worktree with a linked pull request. {number} is the pull request number, {state} the state word (open, merged, closed).
sidebar_worktree_row_worktree_menu: Accessible name of the ... button on a worktree row that opens its menu.
